artifacts.name: Hot-spots & cold-spots
artifacts.summary: Global Moran’s I = 0.06. 1 hot-spot and 0 cold-spot neighbourhood(s) of charging stations density (local Moran’s I / LISA). Only 21 sub-areas: too few for the permutation test to establish significance, so read a grey map as "not enough units to tell", not as "no clustering". Use a finer `subarea_mode` or a larger area to make this map informative. Results depend on OpenStreetMap data completeness. If you can, contribute to OSM.
artifacts.description:
Sub-areas classified by the local Moran’s I statistic (LISA) over charging stations density: **High-High** = a dense neighbourhood surrounded by others like it (hot-spot); **Low-Low** = a sparse one among others like it (cold-spot); **High-Low / Low-High** = spatial outliers. Significance uses a deterministic permutation test; non-significant sub-areas are greyed out.

Provenance: OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-06-19 · indicator: ev_charging · reachability: straight-line distance.

artifacts.name: Charging provision (weakest link)
artifacts.summary: A combined layer (weakest link) of 1×EV charging stations, 1×Rapid / DC charging, per sub-area. Results depend on OpenStreetMap data completeness. If you can, contribute to OSM.
artifacts.description:
Map algebra: for each administrative sub-area, the normalised densities of the input categories are combined by **weakest link** — 1×EV charging stations, 1×Rapid / DC charging — into a single value. Each category is first rescaled to 0–1 across sub-areas, so the value is a unitless index. Use it to express a composite index (e.g. a weighted suitability score) as one layer instead of several.

Provenance: OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-06-19 · indicator: ev_charging · reachability: straight-line distance.

artifacts.name: Provision per capita

artifacts.description:

artifacts.summary: A gridded density of charging stations across the area — brighter means more. Results depend on OpenStreetMap data completeness. If you can, contribute to OSM.
artifacts.description:

artifacts.name: Charging stations density surface
artifacts.summary: A smoothed, continuous density surface of charging stations (kernel-style). Results depend on OpenStreetMap data completeness. If you can, contribute to OSM.
artifacts.description:
A kernel-smoothed density of charging stations: the point counts are blurred into a continuous surface so clusters show as smooth hot regions rather than individual grid cells — a boundary-free complement to the sub-area choropleth and the raw heatmap.

Provenance: OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-06-19 · indicator: ev_charging · reachability: straight-line distance.

artifacts.name: Charging stations per resident (surface)
artifacts.summary: A continuous surface of charging stations per 1,000 residents — provision relative to need, without administrative boundaries. Results depend on OpenStreetMap data completeness. If you can, contribute to OSM.
artifacts.description:
Kernel-smoothed charging stations density divided by population density on the same grid, scaled to per 1,000 residents. Unlike the per-capita choropleth this owes nothing to administrative boundaries, so gradients *within* a district are visible; the trade-off is that it is a smoothed estimate rather than an exact count per area. Cells with fewer than 1 residents are left transparent, because dividing by a nearly empty cell produces a large figure that reflects the arithmetic rather than good provision. Populated cells with no feature within reach are drawn in the lowest class, not left blank — they are the worst-served places and the reason to read this map.

Provenance: OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-06-19 · indicator: ev_charging · reachability: straight-line distance.

artifacts.name: Distance to nearest charging station
artifacts.summary: How far to the nearest charging station from anywhere in the area (metres). Darker = further. Results depend on OpenStreetMap data completeness. If you can, contribute to OSM.
artifacts.description:
A regular grid over the area, each cell shaded by the straight-line distance to the nearest charging station. Dark cells are the furthest from any feature — the access gaps. Straight-line (not routed), so it is an optimistic lower bound; it needs no routing service.

Provenance: OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-06-19 · indicator: ev_charging · reachability: straight-line distance.

artifacts.name: Data currentness
artifacts.summary: How recently each charging station was last edited in OpenStreetMap (median 1 yr ago). Darker = longer since the last edit. Results depend on OpenStreetMap data completeness. If you can, contribute to OSM.
artifacts.description:
Each point is a feature, shaded by the number of years since its last OpenStreetMap edit (measured against the data snapshot). Clusters of dark points mark areas where the OSM picture is ageing and may warrant a re-survey — a spatial companion to the data-quality note.

Provenance: OpenStreetMap data as of 2026-06-19 · indicator: ev_charging · reachability: straight-line distance.
